source_policy: Every image requires item-level rights review. A site's general license does not automatically clear every item or every intended use.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
cautions: Check every file's exact license and attribution requirements

sources.name: Library of Congress
cautions: Use curated Free to Use sets or verify item-level rights; not every catalog item is cleared

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
cautions: Download only items explicitly marked CC0; metadata availability does not mean media is reusable

sources.name: Europeana Fashion
sources.role: Automated discovery and metadata; image access depends on provider
cautions: Check rights badge for each digital object; rights vary by contributing institution

sources.name: FIT SPARC Digital
strengths: Suits, coats, trousers, shoes, shirts and ties
cautions: Rights statements may be territory-specific; check each item

sources.name: Pexels
sources.access: API key required; new key issuance currently paused
sources.role: Potential contemporary styling source; do not bulk automate
cautions: Terms prohibit bulk/systematic copying without permission; API key issuance paused as checked 2026-11-13

sources.name: Pixabay
sources.role: Potential selective stock source; not a bulk archive source
cautions: API terms prohibit systematic mass downloads; cache API responses for 24 hours; store image locally if used

sources.name: Unsplash
sources.access: API key required; demo rate limits apply
cautions: API requires hotlinking returned image URLs and triggering download endpoint for download-like use; not suitable for blind bulk scraping

sources.name: Openverse
sources.access: Current workflow request returned HTTP 401; investigate current authentication requirements
cautions: Do not treat API as operational until authentication is fixed and tested; item-level rights still required

sources.name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access
cautions: General art searches can return irrelevant paintings and objects; use precise category queries and visual relevance checks

sources.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
cautions: Only use records marked public domain with image URLs; results may be archival rather than contemporary

sources.name: Art Institute of Chicago
cautions: Verify public-domain flag and visual relevance
